title: Bluetooth mouse disconnects every afternoon
description: My Logitech MX Master 3 keeps losing its connection in the afternoon. The battery is full and I re-paired it, but it still happens.

worklogs.description: Ran a 2.4 GHz spectrum analysis, identified a congested channel (channel 6).
Checked firmware version and connection type (Bluetooth vs Logi Bolt) via Logi Options+.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hi, your issue is most likely caused by 2.4 GHz interference — especially in the afternoon when office Wi-Fi usage peaks. Connecting over USB with Logitech's 'Logi Bolt' receiver is much more stable than Bluetooth. I can provide a receiver, so you don't need to come into the office. Could you share your building and floor?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Building A, 3rd floor, door 312. I'm not coming to the office tomorrow, I'll be in on Thursday, so I'll manage until then.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Understood. I'll drop a Logi Bolt receiver at your desk on Thursday morning. Setup is automatic, you just need to plug it into USB. In the meantime, to keep the Bluetooth connection a bit more stable: could you try turning off the 'Smart shift' feature in the Logi Options+ app?

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Bolt receiver reserved from stock for Thursday (inventory #LB-2024-058). Waiting on user confirmation — will hold until setup.
